reflection: The only kept factor is the cross-stock range difference (NVDA range minus AAPL range), and the volume z-scores helped in 2 of 4 years. Peer return differences and AAPL-only momentum or volatility ratios mostly failed. I'll try other range and volatility comparisons across stocks (MSFT, QQQ), smoothed versions of the kept factor, and new ideas built on range and volume.

factors.name: msft_range_vs_aapl_range
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(MSFT_High, MSFT_Low), MSFT_Close), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close))
factors.hypothesis: Relative intraday range of MSFT versus AAPL shows whether AAPL is calm relative to its peers, which signals a mean-reverting catch-up.

factors.name: nvda_range_vs_aapl_range_5d
factors.hypothesis: Smoothing the kept range spread over 5 days gives a steadier read on the risk-appetite regime.

factors.name: nvda_range_vs_qqq_range_zscore
factors.hypothesis: NVDA range relative to the market range, standardised, measures speculative excess in tech and affects next-day AAPL direction.

factors.name: qqq_range_vs_aapl_range
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(QQQ_High, QQQ_Low), QQQ_Close), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close))
factors.hypothesis: When the market range is wide relative to AAPL's own range, AAPL is under-reacting and may catch up.

factors.name: aapl_range_zscore_60_proxy
factors.hypothesis: An unusually wide AAPL range compared with its recent norm signals stress and reversal.

factors.name: nvda_overnight_gap
factors.hypothesis: NVDA's overnight gap reflects news sentiment in tech that spills over into AAPL's next move.
